items.meaningEn: 1. strong and well 2. good for your body
examples: A healthy breakfast can give you more energy.

items.meaningEn: to protect someone or something from danger
examples: The brave soldiers defended our country.

items.meaningEn: to move someone or something from one place to another
examples: Monkeys carry their babies all day long.

items.meaningEn: to go and get someone or something
examples: The school bus collects the children each morning.

items.meaningEn: things that are true or that really happened
examples: It's a fact that Earth goes around the Sun.
